instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace all mentions of 'DHL SmartTime' with ONLY 'SmartTime' across the Login view, headers, page titles, and dialogs.
2. Render the custom iOS-inspired DHL SmartTime Clock icon component (`SmartTimeLogo`) inside `/app/frontend/src/components/` and use it on the Login page and Navigation header.
3. Keep mandatory DHL colors: DHL Postyellow (#FFCC00) and DHL Red (#D40511) for key actions, status badges, and highlights.
4. Ensure area selector ('I2M' or 'PKCG') stays compulsory on login before user proceeds to auth.
5. Use proper rounded corners (`rounded-lg` or `rounded-xl`) and subtle shadows (`shadow-sm` or `shadow-md`) aligned with modern corporate design.
6. Verify dark mode compatibility using class `theme-dark` / `dark` ensuring text has APCA contrast over dark slate backgrounds.
7. Attach `data-testid` to all form controls, submit buttons, links, and table elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain clean corporate aesthetic without AI slop, avoiding excessive gradients on text or muddy backgrounds.
Use generous padding in table cells (`py-3.5 px-4`) and card bodies (`p-6 sm:p-8`) to give data room to breathe.
Never hide header dropdown contents or use 100% transparent nav headers without a backdrop blur or high contrast background.
Always provide explicit text contrast on hover states (e.g. `hover:bg-[#B9040F] hover:text-white`).
Ensure responsiveness on mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
